title: 32 · only_his_son · Only His Son
lines: n
The army of heaven was once led by a seven-day-old child.
n
He was the only one alive who could win.
n
The demon Taraka had chosen his death carefully.
Only a son of Shiva can kill me.
"Only a son of Shiva can kill me."
n
Shiva was a monk who had sworn off the world.
It was the safest boon ever asked.
n
Then Parvati happened.
n
A spark fell from Shiva,
so bright that even the god of fire could not hold it.
n
He dropped it in the Ganga. She could not hold it either.
She laid it in a bed of reeds.
n
Six babies were born on six lotus leaves.
Six star-mothers came down and nursed them.
n
When Parvati arrived, she gathered all six in one hug so tight
that they became one boy. With six faces.
n
Seven days later, he walked onto the battlefield,
and Taraka laughed at the size of him.
n
He threw the spear once.
n
What you are meant to do will not wait for you to feel ready. That is sadhana.
n
Kailasa. On Google Play.
